query:
WITH $nodes AS ns,$relationships AS rs
WHERE size(ns)>0 AND size(rs)>0 AND ns=$frozenNodes AND rs=$frozenRelationships
AND all(n IN ns WHERE all(t IN $frozenTypes[n.properties.uid] WHERE valueType(n.properties[t.key])=t.type))
AND all(r IN rs WHERE all(t IN $frozenTypes[r.properties.uid] WHERE valueType(r.properties[t.key])=t.type))
AND size(reduce(xs=[],n IN ns|CASE WHEN n.properties.uid IN xs THEN xs ELSE xs+[n.properties.uid] END))=size(ns)
AND size(reduce(xs=[],r IN rs|CASE WHEN r.properties.uid IN xs THEN xs ELSE xs+[r.properties.uid] END))=size(rs)
AND all(n IN ns WHERE coalesce(n.properties.uid STARTS WITH 'V01:' AND n.properties.caseId='V01' AND n.properties.datasetId='V01' AND n.properties.sourceModelSha256=$sourceModelSha256 AND 'KGItem' IN n.labels AND 'V01' IN n.labels AND all(l IN n.labels WHERE l IN ["AnalysisCollection","AnalysisRule","Building","Column","ComparisonResult","Courtyard","DatasetSnapshot","Demo","DwellingUnit","Element","Entity","EntranceInterface","Evidence","ExternalTransition","GeometryRepresentation","GroundProfile","Interface","KGItem","ReferenceDatum","Roof","RoofSurface","Source","Space","SpatialReference","StreetSegment","SyntheticSource","V01","Wall","Zone","材质_木","材质_灰泥","材质_砖","材质_陶瓦"]),false))
AND all(r IN rs WHERE coalesce(r.properties.uid STARTS WITH 'V01:' AND r.properties.caseId='V01' AND r.properties.datasetId='V01' AND r.properties.sourceModelSha256=$sourceModelSha256 AND r.type IN ["APPLIES_RULE","ASSOCIATED_WITH","AXIS_JOINS","BOT_CONTAINS_ELEMENT","BOT_HAS_BUILDING","BOT_HAS_SPACE","BOUNDARY_PARTICIPANT","COMPARES_REFERENCE","COMPARES_SUBJECT","DECLARES_RULE","DIRECT_ACCESS_TO","DOCUMENTS","ENVELOPE_INTERSECTS","FACADE_PARTICIPANT","HAS_ANALYSIS_MEMBER","HAS_COMPARISON","HAS_SOURCE","INTERFACE_OF","MEMBER_OF_ZONE","PART_OF","PLAN_POSITION","REFERENCES_GROUND","SHARES_BOUNDARY","SPATIAL_RELATION","STREET_BOUNDARY_PARTICIPANT","SUPPORTS_SYSTEM","USES_ANALYSIS_RULE","USES_DATUM"] AND size([n IN ns WHERE n.properties.uid=r.source])=1 AND size([n IN ns WHERE n.properties.uid=r.target])=1,false))
OPTIONAL MATCH (n) WHERE n.caseId='V01' OR n.datasetId='V01' OR n.uid STARTS WITH 'V01:'
WITH ns,rs,collect(n) AS existing
WHERE size(existing)=size($oldNodes) AND size(existing)>0 AND all(n IN existing WHERE single(o IN $oldNodes WHERE n.uid=o.key AND properties(n)=o.properties AND size(labels(n))=size(o.labels) AND all(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN o.labels) AND all(t IN o.types WHERE valueType(n[t.key])=t.type)))
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r]->(b)
WHERE a IN existing OR b IN existing OR r.caseId='V01' OR r.datasetId='V01' OR r.uid STARTS WITH 'V01:'
WITH ns,rs,existing,collect({a:a,r:r,b:b}) AS es
WHERE size(es)=size($oldRelationships) AND all(e IN es WHERE single(o IN $oldRelationships WHERE e.r.uid=o.key AND e.a.uid=o.source AND e.b.uid=o.target AND type(e.r)=o.type AND properties(e.r)=o.properties AND all(t IN o.types WHERE valueType(e.r[t.key])=t.type)))
AND size(ns)=size(existing)
AND all(n IN ns WHERE single(o IN $oldNodes WHERE n.properties.uid=o.key AND size(n.labels)=size(o.labels) AND all(l IN n.labels WHERE l IN o.labels)))
AND all(o IN $oldRelationships WHERE single(r IN rs WHERE r.properties.uid=o.key AND r.source=o.source AND r.target=o.target AND r.type=o.type))
WITH ns,rs,existing,es,[r IN rs WHERE NOT r.properties.uid IN [o IN $oldRelationships|o.key]] AS additions
WHERE size(additions)=5 AND all(r IN additions WHERE r.type='BOUNDARY_PARTICIPANT' AND r.properties.uid='V01:BOUND-'+substring(r.source,4)+'-'+substring(r.target,4) AND [r.source,r.target] IN [['V01:S04','V01:C01'],['V01:S04','V01:C02'],['V01:S04','V01:C03'],['V01:S04','V01:C04'],['V01:S06','V01:W10']])
CALL { WITH ns UNWIND ns AS row MATCH (n:KGItem {uid:row.properties.uid}) SET n=row.properties RETURN count(*) AS nodesUpdated }
CALL { WITH rs UNWIND rs AS row MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE r.uid=row.properties.uid SET r=row.properties RETURN count(*) AS relationshipsUpdated }
CALL { WITH additions UNWIND additions AS row MATCH (a:KGItem {uid:row.source}),(b:KGItem {uid:row.target}) CREATE (a)-[r:BOUNDARY_PARTICIPANT]->(b) SET r=row.properties RETURN count(*) AS relationshipsCreated }
RETURN nodesUpdated,relationshipsUpdated,relationshipsCreated
